RRT.name: Run specified task
RRT.description: Runs the specified task. Loads it if not already loaded.

RCA.name: Switch active task
RCA.description: Switches the active task to the specified task.

RLA.name: Load task
RLA.description: Loads the specified task and makes it the active task.

RUT.name: Unload task
RUT.description: Unloads the specified task. Task data is not deleted.

RCC.name: Reset counters
RCC.description: Resets the counters of the active task to 0.

SSD.name: System shutdown
SSD.description: Exits VTV-9000 and shuts down the OS.

SSA.name: Set active task single-contact trigger
SSA.description: Sets the single-contact trigger for the active task.

SST.name: Set single-contact trigger
SST.description: Sets the single-contact trigger for the specified task.

SGI.name: Save image file
SGI.description: Saves the currently displayed image to a file.

SIE.name: Delete image files
SIE.description: Deletes image files in the active task.

SMA.name: Add text to saved image
SMA.description: Sets text information on the saved image of the active task. The number of line-number digits follows the connection settings.

SGS.name: Save screen file
SGS.description: Saves the displayed main screen to a file.

SLP.name: Set lot
SLP.description: Sets the lot number and lot name. Examples: 0001 / N0001 / SLotName / N0001SLotName

SLH.name: Suspend lot
SLH.description: Suspends the lot and writes the held data to a file.

SLI.name: Increment lot number
SLI.description: Adds the specified value to the current lot number. The number of digits follows the lot number setting of the device.

RWC.name: Write counter data
RWC.description: Writes the counter values to the log or lot file.

COA.name: Output active task parameters to CSV
COA.description: Outputs the setting parameters of the active task to CSV.

CPO.name: Output task parameters to CSV
CPO.description: Outputs the setting parameters of the specified task to CSV.

CIA.name: Input active task parameters from CSV
CIA.description: Inputs setting parameters to the active task from CSV.

CPI.name: Input task parameters from CSV
CPI.description: Inputs setting parameters to the specified task from CSV.

SFS.name: Set / get save folder
SFS.description: Sets or gets a system folder. Leave the path empty when getting.

SFI.name: Increment save folder number
SFI.description: Increments the trailing number of the system folder name by the specified amount.

SOS.name: Start distributed system operation
SOS.description: Starts operation of the distributed system.

SOP.name: Stop distributed system operation
SOP.description: Stops operation of the distributed system.

TCA.name: Set active task tool comment
TCA.description: Sets the tool comment of the active task.

POA.name: Get DIO output
POA.description: Gets the contact outputs of the specified DIO unit as an 8-digit hexadecimal number.

POP.name: Get DIO port output
POP.description: Gets the contact output of the specified port.

PIA.name: Set DIO input
PIA.description: Sets the contact inputs as an 8-digit hexadecimal number.

PIP.name: Set DIO port input
PIP.description: Sets the input state of the specified port.

PLI.name: Set PLI ports
PLI.description: Turns the PLCLINK virtual inputs (PLI/PLO) ON/OFF. Equivalent to PIP over TCP. Separate multiple ports with commas; specify ranges as 5-8.

ESI.name: Set ESI ports
ESI.description: Turns the Field Network ESI ON/OFF. Equivalent to PIP over TCP. Separate multiple ports with commas; specify ranges as 5-8.

EXP.name: Export
EXP.description: Runs an export. For TCP, this is the argument string of S002. For PLCLINK / Field Network, these are the type-specific parameters of command 70.

IMP.name: Import
IMP.description: Runs an import. For TCP, this is the argument string of S002. For PLCLINK / Field Network, these are the type-specific parameters of command 71.

MTT.name: Inspection test
MTT.description: Runs an inspection test using the inspection images in the specified folder.

MCA.name: Set active task coordinate system count
MCA.description: Sets the repeat count of the multi-coordinate-system tool. A camera or line number of 0 means unspecified. Not available for free placement.

MAA.name: Active task automatic character teaching
MAA.description: Automatically cuts out character models with the specified character inspection tool.

MMA.name: Active task manual character teaching
MMA.description: Displays the manual character teaching screen of the specified character inspection tool.

MAC.name: Active task delete all characters
MAC.description: Deletes all character models and positioning models of the specified character inspection tool.

DAA.name: Active task automatic reference image registration
DAA.description: Adds the image captured at command execution to the reference images of the specified DefFinder.

DMA.name: Active task manual reference image registration
DMA.description: Displays the reference image settings screen of the specified DefFinder.

DLA.name: Active task delete last reference image
DLA.description: Deletes one reference image (the most recent) of the specified DefFinder.

DDA.name: Active task delete all reference images
DDA.description: Deletes all reference images of the specified DefFinder.

KMA.name: Set active task module parameters
KMA.description: Sets the fixed point coordinates in the composite module of the Measurement Edit tool. A camera, line, or module number of 0 means unspecified.

DFA.name: Set / get active task image save folder
DFA.description: Sets or gets the image save folder of the Image + Shape Reference Display tool. Leave the folder name empty when getting.

WAS.name: Reset active task text
WAS.description: Resets the OCV tool text. The character count can also be changed. To set multiple blocks, enter them in the additional definition starting from ",BL...".

multi_position.label: Character position for adding multiple characters

WAA.name: Replace all active task text
WAA.description: Replaces all of the OCV tool text without changing the character count.

multi_position.label: Character position for adding multiple characters

WAC.name: Replace characters at specified positions (active task)
WAC.description: Replaces only the characters at the specified positions in the OCV tool.

WMS.name: Reset specified task text
WMS.description: Resets the OCV text of the specified task. The character count can also be changed.

multi_position.label: Character position for adding multiple characters

WMA.name: Replace all specified task text
WMA.description: Replaces all of the OCV text of the specified task without changing the character count.

multi_position.label: Character position for adding multiple characters

WMC.name: Replace characters at specified positions (specified task)
WMC.description: Replaces only the characters at the specified positions in the OCV of the specified task.

NAA.name: Active task automatic reference image registration
NAA.description: Adds a reference image to the inspection point or segment of the specified MatrixDefFinder / SegmentDefFinder. A camera, line, or region number of 0 means unspecified.

allow_search_ng.label: Register even if search is NG

NMA.name: Active task manual reference image registration
NMA.description: Displays the inspection settings screen of the specified MatrixDefFinder / SegmentDefFinder.

NLA.name: Active task delete last reference image
NLA.description: Deletes one reference image (the most recent) at the inspection point or segment of the specified MatrixDefFinder / SegmentDefFinder.

NDA.name: Active task delete all reference images
NDA.description: Deletes all reference images at the inspection point or segment of the specified MatrixDefFinder / SegmentDefFinder.

DID.name: Set active task distribution identifier
DID.description: Sets the distribution identifier of the distribution processing tool. A camera or line number of 0 means unspecified.

DDN.name: Set active task distribution identifier (numeric)
DDN.description: Sets the distribution identifier of the distribution processing tool as a number. This is PLCLINK command 75001.

ICA.name: Set calibration data ID
ICA.description: Sets the calibration data ID on the specified image capture tool of the active task. A camera or line number of 0 means unspecified (all targets).
